annotations.text:
This one is live. Click the rail to move between the five operations; the waveform picker, voice count, ADSR sliders, model and target segments and every checkbox all respond.

The CLI line at the foot of each panel rewrites itself as you go — that mirroring is the point, not decoration.

The four moments you cannot click your way into: nothing loaded, a render in flight, a failure, and a finished result.

Each one replaces the panel region only — the chrome around it never moves.
